name: Sparkling Water
description: A pressed clear-glass bottle with a rounded shoulder and narrow neck, holding a faintly tinted, lightly carbonated liquid and sealed with a plain silver tin-plated steel crown cap.
subcategory: glass sparkling-water bottle with crown cap
materials: Pressed clear glass bottle body; tin-plated steel crown cap.
primaryColors: Clear glass with a natural faint water tint; silver metal cap.
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, wordmark, printing, or embossed lettering anywhere on the glass or cap; never add a label or emblem; no props, hands, or presenter in frame; background stays a clean white or very light neutral studio backdrop with soft even lighting only. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the bottle's pressed-glass silhouette, shoulder taper, neck length, faint natural water tint, and plain silver crown-cap shape identical across all four angles; do not simplify the glass's subtle panel facets or the cap's fluted crimp pattern.
